answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks through a scarce-slot auction mechanism, requiring new identities to bid for limited access slots. Each bid must include unique, verifiable contributions—like original sonnets or artwork. As competitors join, the slot price accumulates For example, an attacker might spend over 5,000 tokens just to create ten fake identities, while genuine participants invest in quality work like the soft touch of velvet against skin. This system demands commitment, akin to a cedar tree that becomes taller and more resource-hungry with each added branch.
